title: Texture Atlas Packer with UV Preview
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js that implements an interactive texture atlas packer with real-time UV coordinate preview. The application has two viewports: a 2D atlas canvas on the left (DOM-based, 512x512 pixel canvas element with id 'atlasCanvas') and a 3D Three.js scene on the right showing a textured mesh with UV wireframe overlay.

## Scene Setup
- Split the screen 50/50. Left side: a 2D HTML5 canvas (id='atlasCanvas', 512x512) showing the packed atlas. Right side: a Three.js WebGLRenderer showing a 3D cube (2x2x2) with the atlas texture applied and a UV wireframe overlay.
- Camera: PerspectiveCamera at position (4, 3, 4) looking at origin. OrbitControls enabled.
- Lighting: AmbientLight(0x404040) + DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8) at (5, 10, 5).
- Background color of 3D scene: 0x1a1a2e.

## Texture Regions (Sub-Textures)
- The atlas starts empty (black). The user can add rectangular texture regions to the atlas.
- Maintain a list of packed regions. Each region has: id (auto-increment starting at 1), x, y, width, height (in pixels), color (random distinct HSL color with S=70%, L=60%).
- Regions are packed using a simple shelf/row packing algorithm: place each new region on the current shelf row. If it doesn't fit horizontally, start a new shelf row. Shelf height = tallest item in that row. Track shelfX, shelfY, shelfHeight.

## UI Controls (DOM)
- A control panel (id='controlPanel') positioned top-center with:
  - 'Add Small' button (id='btnAddSmall'): adds a 64x64 region
  - 'Add Medium' button (id='btnAddMedium'): adds a 128x64 region
  - 'Add Large' button (id='btnAddLarge'): adds a 128x128 region
  - 'Add Tall' button (id='btnAddTall'): adds a 64x128 region
  - 'Remove Last' button (id='btnRemoveLast'): removes the last added region and repacks
  - 'Clear All' button (id='btnClearAll'): removes all regions
  - 'Toggle UV Overlay' button (id='btnToggleUV'): toggles UV wireframe overlay visibility on the 3D mesh
  - A span (id='atlasUsage') showing current atlas usage as percentage: 'Usage: XX.X%'
  - A span (id='regionCount') showing 'Regions: N'
- Keyboard shortcuts: '1'=Add Small, '2'=Add Medium, '3'=Add Large, '4'=Add Tall, 'u'=Toggle UV, 'z'=Remove Last, 'c'=Clear All

## Atlas Rendering (2D Canvas)
- Draw each packed region as a filled rectangle with its assigned color on the 2D atlas canvas.
- Draw a 1px white border around each region.
- Label each region with its id number in white text centered in the region.
- Draw a subtle 64px grid overlay in rgba(255,255,255,0.1) across the entire atlas.

## 3D UV Preview
- Create a DataTexture from the atlas canvas pixel data (512x512, RGBA). Update it every time the atlas changes.
- Apply this texture to the cube's material (MeshStandardMaterial).
- UV wireframe overlay: create a LineSegments object using EdgesGeometry or manually computed UV-space edges, rendered in green (0x00ff00) with LineBasicMaterial. This overlay sits slightly offset (scale 1.001) from the cube to prevent z-fighting.
- When UV overlay is toggled off, set its visible=false.

## Packing Algorithm Details
- shelfX starts at 0, shelfY starts at 0, shelfHeight starts at 0.
- For each new region: if (shelfX + region.width > 512), move to next shelf: shelfY += shelfHeight, shelfX = 0, shelfHeight = 0.
- If (shelfY + region.height > 512), reject the region (atlas full, do not add).
- Place region at (shelfX, shelfY). Update shelfX += region.width. Update shelfHeight = max(shelfHeight, region.height).
- On remove/clear, repack all remaining regions from scratch.

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- regions: array of {id, x, y, width, height, color} objects for all packed regions
- regionCount: number of regions
- atlasSize: 512 (constant)
- atlasUsage: float 0-100 representing percentage of atlas area used (sum of region areas / (512*512) * 100), rounded to 1 decimal
- shelfX: current shelf X position
- shelfY: current shelf Y position
- shelfHeight: current shelf row height
- uvOverlayVisible: boolean
- lastAction: string ('init'|'add_small'|'add_medium'|'add_large'|'add_tall'|'remove_last'|'clear_all'|'toggle_uv')
- atlasFull: boolean, true if last add was rejected due to space
- totalPixelsUsed: integer, sum of all region widths*heights
- textureNeedsUpdate: boolean, set true after atlas change, set false after texture upload to GPU
- cameraDistance: float, distance from camera to origin

Initialize lastAction to 'init', uvOverlayVisible to true, regionCount to 0, atlasUsage to 0, atlasFull to false.
physics_constraints: Shelf packing must be deterministic: identical sequence of adds must produce identical layouts. Atlas usage percentage must exactly equal sum(region.width*region.height)/(512*512)*100 rounded to 1 decimal. UV coordinates must map [0,512] pixel space to [0,1] UV space linearly. No region may exceed atlas bounds (512x512). Repacking after removal must produce the same layout as if the remaining regions were added fresh in order.
